history.text: The Baoule and Agni kingdoms formed as Akan groups moved west.
France declared Cote d'Ivoire a colony.
Independence came on 7 August under Felix Houphouet-Boigny.
Cocoa and coffee exports produced rapid growth.
Civil conflict split the country before reunification.

worthSeeing.title: Basilica of Our Lady of Peace:
worthSeeing.text: One of the world's largest churches, at Yamoussoukro.

worthSeeing.title: Tai National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Primary rainforest with chimpanzees, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

worthSeeing.title: Grand-Bassam:
worthSeeing.text: The first colonial capital, with a preserved French quarter.
